title: Does this look familiar?
content: I've always had vivid dreams about mall world, and never knew that so many others also shared similar dreams, but this place is probably the worst of them all in my experiences. The first time I stumbled upon this building I was walking a very beautiful trail with some friends and found an overgrown trail. Then there was a clearing that had this very building and my body immediately shot out danger signs, yet I still went to explore it. Fast forward 3 months and I have a dream I'm inside this place, down at the very bottom of an elevator that won't work. I noticed a group of people that looked like special units moving to a dark corridor to my left, but then my eyes were yanked to the right corridor directly onto bright white eyes in the darkness. I ended up climbing a ladder to escape but narrowly got out. I've had various other dreams about this dark place and the rest of mall world, but this place always fills me with dread, more than the deadly superhighways.
